simple.meaning: בַּצְלוּת (Batslûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Batsluth or Batslith , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בַּצְלוּת (H1213) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:52, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּצְלוּת (H1213) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בַּצְלוּת (H1213) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בַּצְלוּת (Batslûwth) / H1213 is traced through Ezra 2:52, Nehemiah 7:54 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1213. Batsluth בַּצְלוּת proper name, masculine ( stripping ) — head of Israel family at return from exile; ׳בניבֿ Ezra 2:52 = Neh 7:54 Kt; בַּצְלִית 7:54 Qr.
definitions.rootNote: or בַּצְלִית ; from the same as 1211 ; a peeling;
